notes.title: WSS playground User Survey Begins!
notes.notes:
The first WSS Playground user survey is now live! The survey period is from November 15 to November 22 (JST).

■You can participate here: https://enq.bz/wss_survey_en


The survey focuses on Steam gaming preferences and will take about 20 minutes to complete.

Please join us in helping to improve the gaming experience!
